title: Low Disk Space Cleanup Triage
description: Diagnose low disk space, identify safe cleanup targets, run only approved cleanup actions, then verify recovered space.
starter_prompt: Diagnose low disk space and prepare a safe cleanup plan before deleting anything.

phases.prompt: Define cleanup scope. Treat user files, app data, and browser profiles as preserve-by-default unless explicitly approved.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; function Section($n){ Write-Output ('== ' + $n + ' ==') }; $systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($systemRoot)){ throw 'SystemRoot is not set, so Windows cleanup candidates cannot be located' }; Section 'Volumes'; try { Get-Volume -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,HealthStatus,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { throw ('Volume enumeration failed, so free-space evidence is incomplete: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Section 'Common cleanup locations'; $paths=@(); foreach($pair in @(@('TEMP',''), @('LOCALAPPDATA','Temp'), @('USERPROFILE','Downloads'), @('USERPROFILE','Desktop'))){ $base=[System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($pair[0]); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($base)){ Write-Output ('[warning] Environment variable ' + $pair[0] + ' is not set; that cleanup location is unresolved and was skipped'); continue }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pair[1])){ $paths+=$base } else { $paths+=(Join-Path $base $pair[1]) } }; foreach($p in $paths){ if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){ Write-Output ('[warning] Not present: ' + $p); continue }; try { $m=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p;Items=$m.Count;Bytes=[int64]$m.Sum} } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] Could not size ' + $p + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }; Section 'Windows cleanup candidates'; $systemTemp=Join-Path $systemRoot 'Temp'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $systemTemp){ try { $sm=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $systemTemp -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Path=$systemTemp;Items=$sm.Count;Bytes=[int64]$sm.Sum} } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] Could not size ' + $systemTemp + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Output ('[warning] Not present: ' + $systemTemp) }; Section 'Recycle bin estimate'; try { Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object DeviceID,FreeSpace,Size | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { throw ('Win32_LogicalDisk query failed, so the free-space/recycle-bin estimate is missing: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

phases.prompt: Collect read-only free-space and candidate-location evidence. Do not delete files in this phase.
phases.completion: Space pressure and candidate cleanup targets are visible.

phases.prompt: Analyze cleanup targets. Separate safe temp cleanup from user-file review items. Include confidence and any missing evidence.
phases.completion: Safe and review-required targets are separated.

phases.prompt: Ask for explicit user approval before cleanup. Offer restore point handling when system locations or admin cleanup are involved.
phases.completion: Approval and restore point decision are recorded.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $cutoff=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7); $profileRaw=[System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('USERPROFILE'); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($profileRaw)){ throw 'USERPROFILE is not set, so approved temp cleanup cannot be contained to this user profile' }; $tempRaw=[System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TEMP'); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($tempRaw)){ throw 'TEMP is not set, so the temp cleanup target cannot be resolved' }; $localRaw=[System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('LOCALAPPDATA'); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($localRaw)){ throw 'LOCALAPPDATA is not set, so the LocalAppData temp cleanup target cannot be resolved' }; $profileFull=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($profileRaw).TrimEnd('\'); $failures=@(); $removed=0; $targets=@(); foreach($candidate in @($tempRaw, (Join-Path $localRaw 'Temp'))){ $full=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate).TrimEnd('\'); if($targets -contains $full){ continue }; if($full.Length -le $profileFull.Length -or -not $full.StartsWith($profileFull + '\', [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)){ throw ('Refusing to clean a temp path outside the user profile: ' + $full) }; $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if(-not $item.PSIsContainer){ throw ('Temp cleanup target is not a directory: ' + $full) }; if(($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){ throw ('Refusing to clean through a reparse-point temp target: ' + $full) }; $targets+=$full }; foreach($t in $targets){ Write-Output ('== Cleaning old temp files: ' + $t + ' =='); $entries=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $t -Force -ErrorAction Stop; foreach($entry in $entries){ if(($entry.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){ Write-Output ('[skipped] reparse point: ' + $entry.FullName); continue }; $newest=$entry.LastWriteTime; if($entry.PSIsContainer){ try { $children=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { $failures+=('Could not enumerate ' + $entry.FullName + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message); continue }; foreach($child in $children){ if($child.LastWriteTime -gt $newest){ $newest=$child.LastWriteTime } } }; if($newest -ge $cutoff){ continue }; try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $removed++ } catch { $failures+=('Could not remove ' + $entry.FullName + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } }; Write-Output ('Removed ' + $removed + ' temp entries whose newest content predates ' + $cutoff + '. User files, Downloads, Desktop, and browser profiles were not deleted.'); if($failures.Count -gt 0){ throw ('Approved temp cleanup failed for ' + $failures.Count + ' entries: ' + ($failures -join '; ')) }

phases.prompt: Run only user-approved temp cleanup after the approval gate succeeded and the restore point offer. Never delete user documents or downloads automatically. Fail the phase when any target cannot be resolved inside the user profile or any entry cannot be removed.
phases.completion: Every approved cleanup target was removed, or the phase failed with the exact paths and errors.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; try { Get-Volume -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,HealthStatus,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { throw ('Post-cleanup free-space verification failed, so recovered space is not verified: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

phases.prompt: Verify free-space state after approved cleanup and note whether more manual review is needed.
Verify cleanup did not overreach. Check that evidence supports actions and that user data was not targeted.

Create a technician and customer-ready handoff report with evidence, findings, actions/tools used, verification status, artifacts/logs, cleanup status, residual risk, and prioritized follow-up next actions.
Keep logs and reports. Remove only workflow-created scratch files.

acceptance_criteria: Read-only disk-space evidence is collected before cleanup.
Cleanup actions run only after explicit approval.
Final report lists evidence, actions, cleanup status, risks, and follow-up items.
